intro: Every academic teacher has a degree in their subject and a TESOL certificate, and is qualified to teach in Việt Nam.
note: Keep each person to a role and one short line that starts with a verb. Teachers' lines say what they teach as English through the subject ("Teaches English through Maths and Science"), because PRA is a language center; teaching assistants' lines start with "Supports". Subjects in Title Case, no Oxford comma. Leadership first, then teachers, then teaching assistants. `tint` picks the card's colour pair from .team in main.css and just cycles 1 to 6 down the list. `shots` lists photo slugs from photos.json showing that person at work; they become the card's lightbox, and a member with none simply has no lightbox.
